rule: The background is the strictly most frequent colour. All-background columns are separators. The remaining contiguous column groups are bands, each with one pattern colour. Inside band i, every background cell becomes the colour of band (i+1) mod n, so the last band takes the first band's colour. Pattern cells and separators are unchanged.
scope: Within each vertical band, fill its background cells with the next band colour to the right cyclically, preserving pattern cells and all-background separators.

authored_scope: Default: 3-7 bands, drawn once per call; widths 1-4; separators 1-2; heights 4-30 (a synthetic extension of the 10-row fixtures); occasional 0-2 margin columns (a synthetic extension); distinct sampled background and pattern colours; five pattern families with constructive repair. If a layout is over-wide, free widths, gaps and margins are shrunk instead of the whole layout being redrawn. Explicit-only options: 2-9 bands, height 2-30, arbitrary widths and gaps within 30 columns, and fixed masks, colours and margins. Not supported: multicoloured bands, bands spanning separators, and grids wider or taller than 30.
authored_constraints: Background count is strictly greater than every pattern colour's count.
Background and all pattern colours are mutually distinct.
Every band column contains at least one pattern cell, so no band column is a separator.
Every band contains at least one background cell, so the output differs from the input.
Consecutive bands are separated by at least one all-background column.
Total width is at most 30 and height is in 2..30.
Infeasible fixed layouts raise ValueError before sampling; boolean or non-integer controls are rejected.
The default path never produces 2 bands, because 2 bands give no evidence for the direction or the wrap-around.
